# Sound Dip

> A curated directory of sound bath sessions, practitioners, and venues across the United States. Browse sessions by city, compare practitioners, and book your next sound healing experience.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://sounddip.com) — Find sound bath sessions near you
- [Blog](https://sounddip.com/blog) — Guides on sound baths, sound healing, and related practices
- [What Is a Sound Bath?](https://sounddip.com/blog/what-is-a-sound-bath) — Complete guide to sound baths
- [Sound Bath Benefits](https://sounddip.com/blog/sound-bath-benefits) — Research-backed benefits
- [Sound Bath vs. Meditation](https://sounddip.com/blog/sound-bath-vs-meditation) — Key differences explained
- [Gong Bath vs. Sound Bath](https://sounddip.com/blog/gong-bath-vs-sound-bath) — How gong baths differ
- [Types of Sound Baths](https://sounddip.com/blog/every-type-of-sound-bath-explained) — All formats explained
- [Sound Bath NYC](https://sounddip.com/blog/sound-bath-new-york-city) — Sessions in New York City
- [Sound Bath Los Angeles](https://sounddip.com/blog/sound-bath-los-angeles) — Sessions in LA
- [Sound Healing for Anxiety](https://sounddip.com/blog/sound-healing-for-anxiety) — Evidence and guidance
- [How Much Does a Sound Bath Cost?](https://sounddip.com/blog/how-much-does-a-sound-bath-cost) — Pricing guide
- [Are Sound Baths Safe?](https://sounddip.com/blog/are-sound-baths-safe) — Safety considerations
- [Submit a Listing](https://sounddip.com/submit) — Add your sound bath practice

## About

Sound Dip helps people find and book sound bath sessions. The site covers sound bath types (gong baths, crystal bowl sessions, Tibetan bowl sessions), practitioner directories by city, pricing, safety, and the research behind sound healing. Content is written for both newcomers and experienced practitioners.
